name: io.github.bostanyshop-rgb/growtsy
title: Growtsy — free Etsy seller tools
description: Etsy seller tools: listing, title and tag checks, shop name rules, Etsy Help quotes, fees.

tools.name: etsy_listing_text_check
tools.description: The seller pastes their own listing's title and tags (description and photo count optional); Growtsy runs Etsy's published title and tag rules on that text — the same check as the listing checker's "Paste your listing instead" — and returns one verdict and the first thing to fix. Photo sizes, video, renewal and whether the listing is live need Etsy's data and are listed as not checked. No score, no sales estimate.

title.description: The listing title, as on Etsy

tags.description: The listing's tags, as an array or a comma-separated string

description.description: The listing description (optional; used only to see whether it mentions AI)

photos.description: How many photos the listing has (optional)

tools.name: etsy_title_check
tools.description: Checks one title against Etsy's published title rules (up to 140 characters, fewer than 15 words suggested, no price or shipping, occasions only when essential, no repeated words) plus Growtsy's own checks, which are marked as such. Returns publish as is, or the one thing to fix first. Use for 'is my Etsy title OK?' and 'what is the Etsy title character limit?'.

tools.name: etsy_tag_check
tools.description: Checks a tag set against Etsy's tag rules (up to 13 tags, up to 20 characters each, allowed characters) and flags duplicates, tags with the same words in another order, single-word tags and tags that repeat the title (pass the title for that). Returns one verdict. No search volume: Etsy shows search counts only to each seller, in Marketplace Insights.

tags.description: The tags, as an array or a comma-separated string

tools.name: etsy_shop_name_rules
tools.description: Checks up to 6 shop names against Etsy's shop name rules (4-20 characters, no spaces or special characters), suggests Etsy's form for a name with spaces, quotes Etsy's naming rules, and gives an etsy.com/shop/<name> link the seller can open themselves. It cannot say whether a name is taken, and a missing shop never means a name is free: Etsy does not reuse names of closed shops.

names.description: Up to 6 names, as an array or a comma-separated string

tools.name: etsy_seller_answer
tools.description: Finds the closest of Growtsy's Etsy seller questions (reviews, messages, orders and shipping labels, refunds, listings, payments and deposits, account and shop settings) and returns Etsy Help Center sentences quoted word for word, each with the article, its id and the date Etsy last edited it, plus the Growtsy answer page. Deterministic word match, no AI, no paraphrase; 'no_match' when nothing fits. Use for 'how does Etsy … ?' questions about Etsy's own rules.

tools.name: etsy_fee_calculator
tools.description: Etsy's fees for one order in the seller's country: listing fee, transaction fee, payment processing, regulatory operating fee and VAT on fees, from Etsy's published rates. Assumes no sales tax on the order and no Offsite Ads.

country.description: Seller country: ISO code (US, GB, TR…) or name

shipping.description: Shipping charged to the buyer in USD (default 0)
